methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
WFP publishes reports both on the marketing site (wfp.org/publications) and through a document service at docs.wfp.org. The docs.wfp.org JSON API (/api/documents/) exists and matches the expected schema, which would be the ideal ingestion path, but it now requires authentication. Absent credentials, WFP is treated as a url-catalog over the publications listing.

## Search
The intended API is GET https://docs.wfp.org/api/documents/ with `title_q` (title query), `order`, `page` (1-based) and `per_page`, returning `{ documents: [...], total_count }` where each document has title, url, publication_date and wbs_code. Live probing returned HTTP 401 ('Authentication credentials were not provided') on the anonymous call, so this is captured in config._intendedApi for promotion once a token is available. The HTML fallback is the /publications listing; its search query string (?search=) is Cloudflare-challenged (HTTP 202) for non-browser clients, so prefer crawling the listing and following pagination.

## Filters
The API would support ordering via `order` and title filtering via `title_q`; date/type facets are not documented as anonymous params. No usable HTML filter params.

## Download
Via the API, each document object exposes a direct `url` to the file. Anonymously, fetch the /publications/{slug} landing page and extract the PDF link (assets under docs.wfp.org or wfp.org/media).

## Metadata & Enrichment
With API auth, metadata is inline in documents[] (no extra call). Anonymously, scrape landing-page meta tags.

## Limitations
Two blockers: (1) docs.wfp.org/api/documents/ requires authentication (HTTP 401) — supply a token to unlock the clean rest-api path; (2) the wfp.org HTML search is behind Cloudflare and challenges query-string requests (HTTP 202). The static /publications listing (HTTP 200) is the safe harvest surface. Recommendation: url-catalog now with linkFilter '/publications/'; promote config._intendedApi to family 'rest-api' when WFP API credentials are obtained.
probeNotes: GET https://docs.wfp.org/api/documents?per_page=2&page=1 -> HTTP 301 -> follows to https://docs.wfp.org/api/documents/?... -> HTTP 401 {"detail":"Authentication credentials were not provided."}. Confirms the API exists with trailing-slash canonical URL but is now auth-gated (previously/expected anonymous). GET https://www.wfp.org/publications -> HTTP 200 (harvestable). GET https://www.wfp.org/publications?search=climate -> HTTP 202 (Cloudflare challenge on query string). verified=false: no anonymous data path; intended rest-api config preserved for when credentials are provided.
